privacy.subtitle: Legal
privacy.description: How OMW collects, uses and protects your personal data when you visit our website or contact us.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: This website (www.omw.al) is operated by OMW – On My Way, with its head office at Dëshmorët e 4 Shkurtit Street, Sky Tower Floor 7/3, Tirana, Albania. We are the controller of the personal data described in this policy.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: We only collect the data we need to respond to you and to keep this website running well:
items: Contact form data: your first name, last name, email address, subject and message.
Your email address, if you sign up for price notifications, together with the date and the page you signed up from.
Anonymous usage statistics: pages visited, referring website, device type, browser and country — collected without cookies and without identifying you personally.
Preferences stored on your device: the language you selected for the website.

sections.title: How we use your data
items: To answer the questions, requests and offers you send us through the contact form.
To send you email notifications when fuel prices change, if you have signed up for them.
To understand how the website is used and improve its content and performance.
To remember your language preference between visits.
To comply with our legal obligations under Albanian law.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: We process your data on the basis of your consent (when you send us a message or sign up for price notifications), our legitimate interest in operating and improving the website, and, where applicable, to fulfil legal obligations, in accordance with the Albanian legislation on personal data protection.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The OMW website does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Our analytics service works without cookies. We store your selected language in your browser's local storage so the website opens in the same language next time. We also store there whether the price-notification signup window has been shown to you or whether you have signed up, so it does not appear too often. You can clear it at any time from your browser settings.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: To provide some features, we rely on trusted third-party providers, who process data only as needed to deliver their service:
items: Google Maps — the interactive map and directions on the Locations page. When you use the map, Google may process data in accordance with its own privacy policy.
Email service provider — to deliver the messages you send through the contact form to our team.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: Messages sent through the contact form are kept only for as long as needed to handle your request and any follow-up communication, unless a longer period is required by law. Analytics data is kept in aggregated, anonymous form. Email addresses for price notifications are kept until you unsubscribe. To protect against abuse, we store the IP address a signup comes from only in encoded (hashed) form, never the full IP address.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Albanian data protection law, you have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction of inaccurate data.
Request deletion of your data.
Object to or restrict certain processing.
Withdraw your consent at any time, including unsubscribing from email notifications.
File a complaint with the Commissioner for the Right to Information and Personal Data Protection (IDP).

sections.title: Data security
paragraphs: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and restricted access to the information you send us.

sections.title: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed. For any question about your personal data, write to us at legal@atoil.al or call +355 4 222 1666/177.

terms.subtitle: Legal
terms.description: The conditions that apply when you use the OMW website and the information published on it.

sections.title: Acceptance of terms
paragraphs: By accessing and using www.omw.al, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the website.

sections.title: About OMW
paragraphs: OMW – On My Way is a fuel station network in Albania, with its head office at Dëshmorët e 4 Shkurtit Street, Sky Tower Floor 7/3, Tirana. This website provides information about our stations, products, services and fuel prices.

sections.title: Fuel prices
paragraphs: Fuel prices shown on the website are for information only and are updated daily. Prices may change during the day and may differ between stations. The price that applies to your purchase is always the one displayed at the pump at the moment of refuelling.

sections.title: Information on the website
paragraphs: We do our best to keep the information about our locations, opening hours, products and services accurate and up to date. However, we do not guarantee that all content is complete or free of errors at all times, and it may change without prior notice.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: When using the website, you agree not to:
items: Use the website for any unlawful purpose.
Send false, offensive or misleading messages through the contact form.
Attempt to access restricted areas of the website or interfere with its security or operation.
Copy or collect content from the website by automated means without our permission.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The OMW name, logo, texts, images and design of this website are the property of OMW or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced, distributed or used for commercial purposes without our prior written consent.

sections.title: Third-party links
paragraphs: The website may contain links to third-party services, such as Google Maps for directions. We are not responsible for the content, availability or privacy practices of those services.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: OMW is not liable for any damage resulting from the use of, or inability to use, the website, or from reliance on the information published on it, to the extent permitted by law.

sections.title: Privacy
paragraphs: The use of your personal data is described in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms.

sections.title: Governing law and changes
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Albania, and any dispute will be resolved by the competent courts in Tirana. We may update these terms at any time; the updated version applies from the date it is published on this page. For questions, contact us at legal@atoil.al.
